payout_quote: Current Members age 18 or older may earn a $100 bonus for each eligible New Member they refer who joins Addition Financial Credit Union (AFCU) and opens a qualifying account.
steps: Be an Addition Financial Credit Union member 18+
Refer someone who has not been an AFCU member within the past six (6) months
Friend joins AFCU and opens a qualifying account
You earn a $100 bonus, generally paid within ten (10) days of the new member's account opening
catches: Cap: up to six (6) referral bonuses per current member ($600 maximum)
New member must not have been an AFCU member within the past six (6) months; accounts closed within the past 90 days or with a negative balance are not eligible
Employee and youth savings accounts are not eligible
New members have 90 days from account opening to complete promotion requirements; direct deposits must be verified recurring payroll/pension/government payments (no PayPal/Venmo)
Offer may not be combined with other incentive offers; subject to change or termination without notice
biggest_catch: You get $100 quickly (within ~10 days) — but only for genuinely new members, capped at six ($600), and the friend's direct deposits must be real payroll income.
eligibility: Addition Financial CU members 18+; referred friends must be new-to-AFCU (not a member within 6 months)
timing: Bonus generally paid within 10 days of the new member's account opening
